awareness.name: Ren Amamiya
awareness.r0_detail:
At the end of Ren's action, gain 1 Will of Rebellion stack for each foe with less than 60% HP (up to 5 stacks).
When Will of Rebellion reaches 3 stacks, gain an extra action.
An additional extra action cannot be gained during the extra action. (Extra actions do not affect the duration of effects with turn limits).
At the end of an extra action, spend 3 Will of Rebellion stacks.
*Can gain 1 Will of Rebellion stack per foe per battle.
awareness.r1_detail: Increase skill damage to the main target by 30%, and increase skill damage to other targets by 10%.
awareness.r2_detail: On an extra action, decrease SP cost of skills by 80%. When Ren's SP is above 60%, increase Attack by 50%.
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Arsène's Chains and Thief Tactics by 3.
awareness.r4_detail: Highlight Enhanced: Increase number of Will of Rebellion stacks gained to 3.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Trickster's Plunder and Phantom Omen by 3.
awareness.r6_detail:
After taking an extra action, if there are foes with below 25% HP, deal damage to those foes equal to up to 250% of Ren's Attack (once per enemy per battle).
After using a skill on an extra action, deal Curse damage equal to 50% of Attack to all foes.

weapon4-1.description: Increase Attack by 12.0%/12.0%/16.0%/16.0%/20.0%/20.0%/24.0%. When attacking a foe with an ailment, increase Attack by 19.1%/24.8%/24.8%/30.5%/30.5%/36.2%/36.2%.

weapon5-1.name: Phoenix Dagger
weapon5-1.description: Increase Attack by 30.0%/30.0%/39.0%/39.0%/48.0%/48.0%/57.0%. After gaining Will of Rebellion, increase Ren's Curse damage by 10.0%/13.0%/13.0%/16.0%/16.0%/19.0%/19.0% for 2 turns. Stacks up to 3 times. At 3 or more Will of Rebellion stacks, increase Ren's next damage by 23.0%/30.0%/30.0%/37.0%/37.0%/44.0%/44.0%.

integration.definition: Replace the legacy record by id in the live registry. Do not merge legacy estimated skills or buffs.
integration.hooks: Initialize after live unit construction; call beforeSkill once on the cloned skill before payment, beforeDamage per target, and afterSkill once after cast resolution. After a normal action is consumed, call getExtraActionRequest. If present, retain Joker without beginActorTurn, SP recovery, owner cooldown/status ticks, navigator cooldown decrement, action-number increment, or extra turnActionsUsed; call onExtraActionStart, then onActionEnd({ isExtraAction: true }) exactly once before clearing the scheduler marker. Timed effects preserve because no status tick runs. Shared Highlight, score, and ally-counted listeners are engine-policy decisions not asserted here.
integration.sourceTier: Explicit index 0..3: characterResearch.sourceTier, then sourceTier alias, then unit default, then 0. Coefficients retain upstream ordering.
